title: Iranian monarchists disrupt Paris event, highlighting bitter diaspora divide
summary: A Paris event on Iranian women's rights attended by French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot was disrupted when diaspora supporters of Reza Pahlavi, the US-based son of Iran's deposed shah, taunted left-leaning opponents of Iran's Islamic regime. The chaos underscored the bitter divides in the Iranian diaspora as the Iran war enters its tenth month.
